note: AC1 — licence review for the real-speech corpora. Every conclusion below quotes FIRST-HAND text that was actually read during this task (a licence file shipped inside the distribution, or the distributor's own licence page), never a search-result summary. SPDX, use-for-internal-evaluation, and redistribution-of-individual-samples are answered per dataset.

datasets.name: THCHS-30 (Tsinghua Continuous Mandarin Speech Database, a.k.a. TCMSD)
datasets.spdx: Apache-2.0 (per the OpenSLR page) — CONFLICTS with the upstream CSLT prose, see discrepancy

evidence.kind: distributor licence page (first-hand), plus the corpus's own README prose
evidence.retrievedVia: curl https://www.openslr.org/18/ (page body read in full)
evidence.upstreamProseVerbatim: We hope to provide a toy database for new researchers in the field of speech recognition. Therefore, the database is totally free to academic users.
evidence.inDistributionLICENSE: NOT FOUND — resource.tgz (24 MB, the supplementary-resources archive) contains only a dictionary and noise samples; data_thchs30.tgz (6.4 GB) was not fully streamed, so no LICENSE file was confirmed inside the audio archive itself.

datasets.discrepancy: OpenSLR labels the corpus Apache-2.0 (a permissive licence that would allow redistribution), while CSLT's own English prose says it is 'totally free to academic users' (which reads as academic-only). These two statements are not reconciled anywhere, so the licence is treated as AMBIGUOUS rather than permissive.

allowedForThisUse.reason: this task is academic/technical evaluation of turn-detection models, which both readings permit ('totally free to academic users' and Apache-2.0).

redistributionOfIndividualSamples.reason: resolving Apache-2.0 (yes) against 'academic users only' (no) requires a legal reading this task will not assert; the conservative reading governs. No THCHS-30 audio is committed to the repository.

acquisitionPath.chosen: HuggingFace datasets-server rows API (https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows) → a signed per-row audio URL → ffmpeg to 16 kHz mono PCM s16le
acquisitionPath.why: a single LibriSpeech FLAC is ~100 kB and THCHS-30's own tarball is 6.4 GB; the rows API returns one per-row audio URL so a handful of samples can be pulled without mirroring a corpus.

usedDatasets.mirrorNote: third-party HF mirror of THCHS-30; the mirror's card declares no licence, so the LICENCE conclusion above is taken from the upstream OpenSLR/CSLT statements, not from the mirror.

As a condition to your use of the LiveKit Materials, you agree: (i) not to use any LiveKit Models on a standalone basis or with any frameworks other than LiveKit Agents; (ii) not to use any LiveKit Materials or any output from, or results of using, LiveKit Models (including any derivative works thereof) to improve or otherwise develop any other models that are not LiveKit Models; or (iii) distribute or otherwise make available the LiveKit Materials (including any derivative works thereof) except (x) pursuant to the terms of this Agreement, and (y) you reproduce the above copyright notice.
livekit-turn-detector.conclusion: Section 3 grants a broad right to 'use, reproduce, distribute, copy, and create derivative works of the LiveKit Materials'; 3.b(i)'s ONLY restriction on use is that it must be together with the LiveKit Agents framework. Driving the model through livekit.agents.inference.TurnDetector(version='v1-mini') in an isolated venv is therefore a LICENSED use, and 3.b(ii) (no improving/developing non-LiveKit models) is not engaged because nothing here trains or modifies any other model. Updated from P0.5's 'blocked-by-license'.
